title: EthrylPaintings
description: Adds custom paintings drawn by me in Minecraft.
body:
## EthrylPaintings is a simple datapack that adds custom paintings drawn by DiaTales(me) in Minecraft.
## Do note the the [Resource Pack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/h1ewIi8g/versions/Gcxc4X3L/EthrylPaintings%201.1.r%2026.1.x.zip?mr_download_reason=standalone) is required for the datapack to work, it can be found on the [Versions](https://modrinth.com/datapack/ethrylpaintings/versions) section of this mod.

As of version 1.1, there are currently 15 new paintings of the following sizes:
1x1, 1x2, 2x1, 2x2, 3x2, 2x4, and 4x3.~~~~

More paintings will be drawn and added in future updates.
